schema_note: Per-function protection status for the Factory's customer-facing generators and shared systems. Seeded 2026-09-12 from a read-only audit -- see PROTECTED_GENERATOR_RULE.md and SESSION_HANDOFF_2026-09-11.md. Status values: LOCKED (proven customer-path fix + machine-checked protected test(s) + known last_known_good_commit), UNLOCKED (an explicit, reasoned, in-progress exception -- see unlocked_by/unlocked_reason), PROTECTED (real test coverage exists but no single commit has been proven as its customer-path last-known-good), UNPROTECTED (no meaningful customer-path test coverage), REGRESSION (currently known broken). last_known_good_commit is null unless a real commit was proven -- never manufactured (Rule 9, PROTECTED_GENERATOR_RULE.md). shared_code_dependencies covers both the function's own dedicated files and any file it shares with other functions -- tests/test_function_lock_enforcement.py treats a trailing '/' as a directory-prefix match.

word_search.unlocked_reason: 2026-09-13: static/js/app.js (a declared shared dependency) is being edited to fix the live ebook build-failure dead end (the 'Try again' button never called /advance again once a build had failed). Word Search's own code and tests are untouched; unlocking only because it shares this file. Will relock once Word Search's protected tests are proven green after the edit.
word_search.notes: The customer-facing route had never used the shared topic engine, in any release, until a021385. No earlier commit is a valid last-known-good for this route. Relocked at ab6b923 (2026-09-13): Word Search's cover now genuinely attempts Pexels first (via is_photo_realistic_cover), falling back to the existing AI path unchanged when no suitable photo is found. Word Search's puzzle-generation/topic-vocabulary behavior is untouched.

coloring_book.notes: LOCKED for the captions-off/no-text contract proven at 984b268. Relocked at ab6b923 (2026-09-13): the automatic build previously had NO final-cover QA at all -- a real gap, now closed by services/coloring_book/final_cover_qa.py, a small adapter that reads the actual rendered PDF page back and blocks on a missing title, placeholder/gibberish text, malformed characters, or an unrecognized cover source. Coloring Book itself still never attempts Pexels (explicitly excluded by product type in cover_agent.py, since its cover must stay branded illustrated artwork, not a photograph). Seven pre-existing *_LOCKED_STATE.md files (2026-07-11/07-12) claimed the captions-off behavior; their manual test theme ('Farm House') never exercised the one illustration branch (_draw_generic_scene) that had the defect, and none were machine-checked. Those files are historical record now, not the source of truth -- this entry is. A separate, unrelated pair of crash bugs was found in _draw_fantasy (dragon/castle themes) during the 984b268 fix and is flagged separately (not part of this lock).

factory_market_advantage.notes: Real, substantial test coverage exists (heavily mocked, algorithm-level: scoring, dedup, fabrication guards). Not LOCKED because: no Fast Gate coverage, no proven customer-path commit, and the 2026-09-11 incident (TAVILY_API_KEY / AI_INTEGRATIONS_OPENAI_API_KEY missing on Render) was entirely invisible to every existing test -- it was a configuration gap, not a code defect, and no test here would have caught it. ebook.notes: Largest test family in the Factory (~31 files in tests/acceptance_manifest.json), but only 1-2 run in the Fast Gate. No single commit has been formally proven as this function's customer-path last-known-good -- not LOCKED until one is. 2026-09-12: added the Global Cover Policy files -- Ebook's cover is the primary product this policy applies to, and it also has its own separate guided Pexels/upload cover system (ebook_photo_cover.py/ebook_pexels.py) which shares Pexels infrastructure with cover_source_policy.py. 2026-09-13: added services/ebook_build_orchestrator.py, services/ebook_project_workspace.py and services/ebook_manuscript_engine.py -- the One-Click Build state machine and its resume/idempotency logic -- as real, previously-undeclared shared dependencies; a live production build got stuck at a 'Try again' dead end because of two bugs in this exact code, fixed this session (see tests/test_ebook_build_resume_recovery.py). Still PROTECTED, not LOCKED: no single commit had been proven as this function's customer-path last-known-good before this fix either, so this does not change that classification.

math_worksheet.notes: Fully independent generator (shares no product-specific code with any other Factory product). Full Gate only -- not in the Fast Gate today.

faith_planner.notes: Shares services/planner/ with Budget Planner -- a Faith-only change can silently affect Budget Planner; one shared test file (37 tests) covers both. The 2026-09-09 matrix noted a 'Save Product' flakiness in one manual browser trial, concluded not a generation defect, but never formally re-verified. 2026-09-12: added services/cover_source_policy.py (Faith Planner's auto-cover-photo flow now runs candidates through its quality gate) and services/product.py (the _planner_pdf_payload function that makes the cover-source decision lives there) as real, previously-undeclared shared dependencies. NOTE: services/product.py is the Factory's largest, most broadly-shared file -- it is intentionally NOT added as a blanket dependency for every other LOCKED/PROTECTED function; it is declared here only because this specific planner cover-choice code was directly edited.

budget_planner.notes: Shares services/planner/ with Faith Planner -- see that entry. Same shared test file covers both. 2026-09-12: added services/cover_source_policy.py and services/product.py for the same reason as Faith Planner's entry.

saved_projects.notes: The one function with real code-level enforcement, not just tests: services/quality/artifact_state.py's DRAFT/APPROVED/LOCKED transition rules genuinely block content mutation in code. Strong candidate for LOCKED; kept at PROTECTED because no single customer-path incident/fix commit was named for it in the 2026-09-12 audit -- upgrade it deliberately, not by default.

pdf_zip_export.notes: Highest-blast-radius shared file in the Factory per the Shared-Service Dependency Map -- every other product above lists services/packaging.py as a dependency too, so a change here should re-run every locked/protected function's suite, not just this one.
